cases.label: 실제 저장 값이 없으면 현재 입력을 보존한다
cases.probe: const prefix=context.storagePrefix+'b05:';const identity={lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r2',fileId:'main'};const key=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r2','main']);try{const store=submission.createDraftStorage(localStorage,prefix,identity);observe({key:store.key.slice(prefix.length),value:store.load('작성 중')});}finally{const cleanupKeys=[];for(let index=0;index<localStorage.length;index++){const candidate=localStorage.key(index);if(candidate?.startsWith(prefix))cleanupKeys.push(candidate);}for(const cleanupKey of cleanupKeys)localStorage.removeItem(cleanupKey);}

cases.label: 실제 Storage에 v2를 쓰고 번호와 내용을 복원한다
cases.probe: const prefix=context.storagePrefix+'b05:';const identity={lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r2',fileId:'main'};const key=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r2','main']);try{const store=submission.createDraftStorage(localStorage,prefix,identity);const saved=store.save('한글 코드',0);observe({saved,loaded:store.load('다른 입력'),stored:JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key))});}finally{const cleanupKeys=[];for(let index=0;index<localStorage.length;index++){const candidate=localStorage.key(index);if(candidate?.startsWith(prefix))cleanupKeys.push(candidate);}for(const cleanupKey of cleanupKeys)localStorage.removeItem(cleanupKey);}

cases.label: 교재 개정과 편집 파일별 실제 키를 분리한다
파손된 JSON을 자동 삭제하거나 덮어쓰지 않는다
알 수 없는 스키마를 현재 버전으로 오인하지 않는다
이전 개정 v1을 명시적으로 이행하고 이전 원문을 남긴다
관찰한 저장 번호가 달라지면 현재 입력을 유지하며 충돌을 알린다
cases.probe: const prefix=context.storagePrefix+'b05:';const identity={lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r2',fileId:'main'};const key=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r2','main']);try{const a=submission.createDraftStorage(localStorage,prefix,identity);const b=submission.createDraftStorage(localStorage,prefix,identity);a.save('첫 저장',0);const conflict=b.save('늦은 입력',0);const saved=a.save('새 저장',1);observe({conflict,saved,loaded:b.load('')});}finally{const cleanupKeys=[];for(let index=0;index<localStorage.length;index++){const candidate=localStorage.key(index);if(candidate?.startsWith(prefix))cleanupKeys.push(candidate);}for(const cleanupKey of cleanupKeys)localStorage.removeItem(cleanupKey);}

cases.label: 실제 Storage에 연결한 실패 어댑터에서 입력과 기존 값을 보존한다
cases.probe: const prefix=context.storagePrefix+'b05:';const identity={lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r2',fileId:'main'};const key=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r2','main']);try{const store=submission.createDraftStorage(localStorage,prefix,identity);store.save('기존',0);const denied={getItem:k=>localStorage.getItem(k),setItem(){throw new DOMException('fixture','QuotaExceededError');}};const failed=submission.createDraftStorage(denied,prefix,identity).save('미저장',1);const unreadable={getItem(){throw new DOMException('fixture','SecurityError');},setItem(){}};observe({failed,read:submission.createDraftStorage(unreadable,prefix,identity).load('읽기 전 입력'),stored:store.load('')});}finally{const cleanupKeys=[];for(let index=0;index<localStorage.length;index++){const candidate=localStorage.key(index);if(candidate?.startsWith(prefix))cleanupKeys.push(candidate);}for(const cleanupKey of cleanupKeys)localStorage.removeItem(cleanupKey);}

cases.label: 현재 개정에 저장한 내용이 있으면 migration으로 덮어쓰지 않는다
맞지 않는 파일·번호·내용 타입을 파손으로 처리한다
cases.probe: const prefix=context.storagePrefix+'b05:';const identity={lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r2',fileId:'main'};const key=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r2','main']);try{const store=submission.createDraftStorage(localStorage,prefix,identity);const base={schemaVersion:2,...identity,sequence:1,text:'ok'};const values=[{...base,fileId:'other'},{...base,sequence:0},{...base,text:7}];const outputs=[];for(const value of values){localStorage.setItem(key,JSON.stringify(value));outputs.push(store.load('입력'));}observe(outputs);}finally{const cleanupKeys=[];for(let index=0;index<localStorage.length;index++){const candidate=localStorage.key(index);if(candidate?.startsWith(prefix))cleanupKeys.push(candidate);}for(const cleanupKey of cleanupKeys)localStorage.removeItem(cleanupKey);}

cases.label: 파손된 이전 개정은 새 초안으로 이행하지 않고 원문을 보존한다
cases.probe: const prefix=context.storagePrefix+'b05:';const identity={lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r2',fileId:'main'};const key=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r2','main']);const oldKey=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r1','main']);try{localStorage.setItem(oldKey,'{bad legacy');const store=submission.createDraftStorage(localStorage,prefix,identity);observe({migration:store.migrateFrom('r1','현재 입력'),current:localStorage.getItem(key),old:localStorage.getItem(oldKey)});}finally{const cleanupKeys=[];for(let index=0;index<localStorage.length;index++){const candidate=localStorage.key(index);if(candidate?.startsWith(prefix))cleanupKeys.push(candidate);}for(const cleanupKey of cleanupKeys)localStorage.removeItem(cleanupKey);}

cases.label: 이행 대상 쓰기가 거부되면 이전 원문과 현재 입력을 유지한다
cases.probe: const prefix=context.storagePrefix+'b05:';const identity={lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r2',fileId:'main'};const key=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r2','main']);const oldKey=prefix+'draft:'+JSON.stringify(['lesson','r1','main']);try{const old={schemaVersion:1,lessonId:'lesson',contentRevision:'r1',fileId:'main',code:'이전'};localStorage.setItem(oldKey,JSON.stringify(old));const storage={getItem:key=>localStorage.getItem(key),setItem(){throw new DOMException('fixture','QuotaExceededError');}};const store=submission.createDraftStorage(storage,prefix,identity);observe({migration:store.migrateFrom('r1','현재 입력'),current:localStorage.getItem(key),old:JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(oldKey))});}finally{const cleanupKeys=[];for(let index=0;index<localStorage.length;index++){const candidate=localStorage.key(index);if(candidate?.startsWith(prefix))cleanupKeys.push(candidate);}for(const cleanupKey of cleanupKeys)localStorage.removeItem(cleanupKey);}
